meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行自动化浏览器操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器完成重复网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser actions from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser interactions for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动打开网页、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取文字、保存PDF，并支持登录、多标签页和移动端Safari自动化。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude“打开一个网站”、“填写表单”、“点击按钮”、“截图”、“提取数据”、“测试网页”或“登录网站”等涉及浏览器操作的任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图首页
say.note: Claude会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我登录 example.com，用户名是 user，密码是 pass
say.note: Claude会填写登录表单并等待跳转。

say.text: 提取当前页面所有商品名称和价格
say.note: Claude会获取页面文本并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically open web pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract text, save PDFs, and supports login, multi-tab, and mobile Safari automation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data", "test a web app", "login to a site", or any browser automation task.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot of the homepage.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log in to example.com with username user and password pass.
say_en.note: Claude will fill the login form and wait for redirect.

say_en.text: Extract all product names and prices from the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will get page text and return results.
